description: Poll a task started by start_asset_flow_run or start_regenerate_asset_flow_node until status is completed, failed or unknown (unknown: access to the run was lost; check get_asset_flow_run before starting another). Then verify the persisted outcome with get_asset_flow_run — a task report alone is not proof.
